claims.excerpt: Fourth Global Coral Bleaching Event Set a Record for Heat-Stress Exposure
claims.claim: The fourth global coral bleaching event set an all-time record for heat-stress exposure.
claims.label: U
claims.evidence: The previous global event ran from 2014 to 2017 and exposed 68.2% of reef area to bleaching-level heat stress.
claims.narrative: The scale of the heat-stress footprint—larger than the 68.2% recorded during the 2014–2017 event—makes the event record-setting by measured exposure, not proof that every exposed reef bleached or died.
claims.explanation: The source establishes a larger footprint than the 2014–2017 event but does not provide comparisons with every earlier period needed to verify an all-time record.
claims.materiality: Material: the title's record claim is central, though the source supports the narrower comparison with the prior event.
